Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Google Cloud SQL instance deletion: how to stop it

What happens

Google Cloud SQL instance deletion. The call below tries to delete cloud resources. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Google Cloud.

The call

gcloud sql instances delete prod-db

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Turn on deletion protection for the Cloud SQL instance (gcloud sql instances patch INSTANCE --deletion-protection), so a delete fails until a person turns it off. Give the agent an IAM role that has neither cloudsql.instances.delete nor cloudsql.instances.update (the Cloud SQL Editor role has update), because update can turn the protection off.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule cloud-delete, first stopped in version 0.33.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
